2. Middle additions (30-60 minutes): Hops added during this time provide a balance between bitterness and flavor. This stage can enhance floral, citrus, or pine notes, depending on the hop variety.

3. Late additions (60 minutes or more): Hops added towards the end of the boil or during the whirlpool stage contribute primarily to aroma and flavor, without adding much bitterness. This is when you'll notice more delicate hop flavors and aromas, such as tropical fruits, herbs, or spices.
